_meta.name: Teen Cigarette Smoking
_meta.unit: percent of 12th graders using cigarettes in the past 30 days
_meta.source: Monitoring the Future (University of Michigan), via CDC/NCHS Data Query System
_meta.note: Monitoring the Future's annual national school survey of 12th graders (roughly 12,000–15,000 students), past-30-day prevalence, crude percent, as republished by NCHS in Health, United States. MTF itself began in 1975; the NCHS mirror starts in 1980. The 2020 survey was cut short by COVID (smaller sample); MTF reports no series break.
_meta.method: SODA https://data.cdc.gov/resource/mtgp-t7vw.json where group='Grade level' and subgroup='12th grade' and subtopic='Cigarettes'
